source_note: UNOFFICIAL LISTING: YouTube playlist "Searle: 3 Philosophy Courses (UC Berkeley)" by uploader SocioPhilosophy (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL553DCA4DB88B0408), reached from the recorded video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zi7Va_4ekko — this is an unofficial upload, not an official UC Berkeley course page; fetched 2026-10-21. The uploader publishes only numbered titles ("Searle: Philosophy of Mind, lecture N") and video descriptions carry only course-level boilerplate (John Searle, Philosophy of Mind, UC-Berkeley Philosophy 132, Spring 2011), so all summaries are title-level only.
